en: Om. Again and again I bow to Shri Rama, who takes away troubles, gives every kind of wealth, and delights the world.
I bow to Ramachandra, who ends the pain of the suffering, destroys the fear of the frightened, and is the rod of death for enemies.
Salutation to Rama, who holds the bow Kodanda with the arrow set on it, who cut down all the demons, and who wards off danger.
Salutation to Rama, the gracious Rama, Ramachandra, the creator, lord of the Raghus, the Lord, the husband of Sita.
May Rama and Lakshmana, mighty and with bows drawn back to the ear, protect me in front, behind and on both sides.
May young Rama, ready for battle, in armour, with sword, bow and arrows, always walking ahead of me, protect me together with Lakshmana.
By the medicine of saying the names Achyuta, Ananta and Govinda, all diseases are destroyed. I say this truly, truly.
Truth, truth and again truth, said with the arm raised: there is no scripture higher than the Veda, and no God higher than Keshava.
When the body is worn out and gripped by disease, the medicine is the water of the Ganga, and the physician is Narayana, Hari.

first: आलोड्य सर्वशास्त्राणि विचार्य च पुनः पुनः।
en: After studying all the scriptures and thinking again and again, this one conclusion is clear: Narayana, Hari, is the one to meditate on.
O God Narayana, forgive whatever syllable or word was missed, or any sound left short. Salutation to you.
O Supreme Person, forgive any visargas, nasal marks, sound lengths, words, verse-quarters or syllables that were too few or too many.
